thread:
jordan: quick check — proposing a 60m cross-functional roundtable next Wed, looking to run RFC reviews + roadmap tradeoffs. need an agenda steward and a 10m pre-read for each RFC. :calendar:
maya: can we shift to 9:30 PT? i have a customer call at 10. also +1 on pre-reads — can we set a 24h deadline?
kevin: 9:30 PT works for me. fyi APAC folks prefer morning PST. if we keep 60m, let’s cap at 3 items.
sam (calendar-bot): poll created — https://poll.example.com/x/roundtable-1777778899 — options: Wed 9:30 PT / Wed 10:30 PT / Thu 9:30 PT
jordan: updated: Wed 9:30 PT, 60m. proposed agenda slots: 1) RFC: serving-routing fallback 2) Design: rollout decision-log review 3) Triage: hotlist (3 items). who will steward each?
eva: i can steward the decision-log review. who can co-steward the serving-routing RFC? i’ll need a brief kernel-selection note for context.
nicole: i can co-steward serving-routing. will drop a 2-page pre-read in the doc and add a decision-log stub.
kevin: perf team will prep a 1-paragraph perf summary for the RFC — include expected p99 tail and cost delta.
maya: pre-read deadline = Tue 9:30 PT (24h before). i’ll own the triage stewarding.
jordan: agenda template — feel free to copy into meeting notes:

```
Agenda (60m)
- 0–10m: quick updates & context
- 10–30m: RFC review (serving-routing) — steward: nicole
- 30–45m: decision-log review — steward: eva
- 45–60m: triage / immediate actions — steward: maya
```

jordan: tagging @eng-oncall for infra heads who want to join.
eng-oncall: noted possible maintenance Thu 00:30 UTC; will flag if that overlaps.
kevin: small ask — can someone paste the kernel-selection notes (one paragraph) into the pre-read? want to keep the meeting tight.
nicole: will add summary + explicit callout: "expected perf impact: +5% latency, -18% cost" and mark it as a highlight in the doc.
eva: adding open questions under a decision column so outcomes are captured.
jordan: checklist before meeting:
- sam: close poll by EOD today
- nicole: upload RFC pre-read by Tue 9:30 PT
- eva: upload decision-log draft by Tue 9:30 PT
- maya: collect triage hotlist by Tue 9:30 PT
- kevin: perf blurb

jordan: if you can’t make it, drop comments inline or DM stewards. thanks :thumbsup:
kevin: pinging @product-analytics for visibility on the cost delta.
sam (calendar-bot): poll closed — Wed 9:30 PT selected (majority). meeting invite sent.
maya: got the invite, thanks. i’ll prep the triage list and flag the top 3 urgent items.
nicole: uploaded pre-read: https://docs.example.com/rfc-serving-routing — pls add inline comments.
eva: decision-log draft: https://docs.example.com/decision-log-rollout — added nicole & eva as co-authors.
jordan: will update the roadmap slot after the meeting and add the decision-log link to meeting notes.
kevin: async q: if we defer a rollout, who signs off? can we add a "signed-off-by" line in the decision-log template?
nicole: yup — will add "sign-off: [team lead] / [eng PM]" field to the template.
jordan: one more note: agenda steward rotation — let’s rotate stewards every two rounds to spread load.
maya: +1 — i’ll take steward for the next triage round after this.
jordan: great — closing loop. see you Wed 9:30 PT. :wave:
